title: Book Three · Chapter 120: The Three Drawings
story:
The winter holiday ends. Several weeks pass, and the first warm spring afternoons arrive.

Anna has three drawings for a small school display. On Wednesday, she lays them on an empty classroom desk.

“Which one is least clear?” she asks Ronan.

He looks at the little room, the front steps, and the covered yard.

“I like them.”

“That doesn't answer the question.”

He smiles, then looks again.

The steps are clear. He can follow them from the street to the door. The yard has two windows above a wide opening.

He points to the room.

“Is this a window or a cupboard?”

Anna sits beside him.

“A cupboard. The window is higher.”

“I thought the handles were little people.”

She looks at them, then laughs quietly.

“Two very thin people.”

She adds a few lines around the cupboard doors. Then she makes the handles darker.

Ronan can see the difference now.

Anna moves the sheet away from him, then brings it back.

“Do you still see the people?”

“Only because I know they were there.”

She puts a piece of paper over the handles.

“Look at the rest for a moment.”

He studies the steps again. Then she lifts the paper.

“A cupboard,” he says.

“Good.”

She sits back and rubs one finger along her pencil. There is a dark mark on her hand. She looks at it, then at her white sleeve, and finds a cloth before she touches the drawing again.

The drawing teacher comes in with a roll of paper. Anna shows her the three sheets and asks about the room.

The teacher points to the high window.

“Where does the light fall?”

Anna looks toward their real classroom window. There is a bright patch on the floor beside the desk.

She turns her drawing around and looks again.

“Here.”

“Show a little of that.”

Anna tries a light line, then rubs it out. Her next line is softer. She works for several minutes while Ronan finishes his own maths beside her.

At last, she puts the pencil down.

The teacher looks again and nods. She takes two of Anna's drawings to the display wall. Anna follows with the paper roll.

Ronan closes his school book and carries the last drawing. Together they place the three sheets beside work from other students.

Kai stops at the steps.

“These look possible.”

“Possible to build?” Anna asks.

“Possible to fall down. For me.”

He points to his own foot and its loose lace. Ronan laughs and points him toward a bench.

Anna writes her name on a small label. She places it below the drawings, then stands back.

Her smile is small at first. Then she sees Lin near the door and waves her over.

Ronan steps aside so Lin can look. He watches Anna explain the light and the high window.

Before they leave, he looks once more at the cupboard handles. They are handles now. Anna catches his eye and holds up two thin fingers like his little people.

He laughs, and she takes her pencil case from the desk.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

display＝展示；handle＝把手；rub out＝擦掉；label＝标签。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan起初把什么看成了什么？Anna怎样让画更清楚？
2. 老师提出什么实际问题？Anna的画是否因此变成录取或获奖结果？

## 读句子

**There is a bright patch on the floor beside the desk.**

拆开看：There is / a bright patch / on the floor / beside the desk.

有／一块明亮的光斑／在地板上／桌子旁边。
